title: Untitled (Targets and Warplane)
description: Dense arrangement of concentric-ring targets in black-and-white, red, blue, and green covers the picture plane, interspersed with a top-down warplane silhouette at center. Compact discs appear along the lower edge, with layered paper, ink scrawls, and transparent plastic sheet overlaying the composition.
composition: Target clusters surrounding central warplane figure
